gaps: First National reports a gross default rate only; its charge-off series is gross of recoveries and is left out of the All Trusts charge-off line.
universe: Figures are the trust's own, as its servicer reports them each month on SEC Form 10-D; trusts define them differently (Methodology §11 lists each trust's definition), so compare trends more than levels.

portfolio_yield: First National's gross yield: computed here: the trust’s finance charge collections (interchange, recoveries, finance charges and fees, discount receivables) ÷ average principal receivables, annualized by days.
excess_spread: First National's excess spread: weighted across series: each publicly reported series’ “Net Yield Percentage” by its collateral amount plus principal accumulation account as of the first day of the month (the base of its yield in the prospectus); a series in its first month is left out, and privately held variable-funding series publish no statement.
